homeTitle: What do you need right now?
homeSubtitle: Choose the moment you are in. BPD Companion will take you to one useful action.

medications.title: Medications
medications.description: Track medication schedules, doses, notes, and today’s taken doses.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Keep therapy, psychiatry, doctor, and group appointments organized.

community.title: Community
community.description: Read and share with others who understand. Peer support, not crisis support or medical advice.

bpdAcademy.title: BPD Academy
bpdAcademy.description: Tiny 2-5 minute lessons for real moments

spotDistortion.title: Spot The Distortion
spotDistortion.description: Identify mind reading, catastrophizing, and more

calmDescription: For intense emotions, panic, or overwhelm. Start Calm Me Down.
pauseDescription: For texting, arguing, or impulsive urges. Create a small gap before action.
triggerDescription: Map what happened into trigger, emotion, fear, and urge.
reflectDescription: After something happened, extract the lesson and what to try next.

structured.completionBody: It has been added to your emotional map so Companion and Insights can use it later.
structured.askCompanion: Ask Companion to help with this step

reflect.title: Extract the lesson
reflect.subtitle: This is for after something happened. Notice what helped, what made it harder, and what you want to try next time.
reflect.purpose: What can I learn from this?

lesson.label: Lesson
lesson.question: What did you learn?
lesson.placeholder: Example: I need to pause before asking for reassurance...

different.label: Next time
different.question: What would you do differently next time?
different.placeholder: Example: Wait 20 minutes, use Don’t Send It, ask directly...

helped.label: Helped
helped.question: What helped?
helped.placeholder: Example: Breathing, walking away, talking to Companion...

worse.label: Harder
worse.question: What made things worse?
worse.placeholder: Example: Checking my phone repeatedly, sending messages quickly...

emotion.label: Emotion
emotion.question: What emotion mattered most in this reflection?

intensity.label: Intensity
intensity.question: How intense was it at the peak?

summary.different: Next time I want to try: {{value}}

trigger.title: Uncover the emotional chain
trigger.subtitle: Slow the moment down: trigger → meaning → fear → urge. This is for understanding what happened emotionally.
trigger.purpose: What did this moment touch in me?

whatHappened.label: Trigger
whatHappened.question: What happened?
whatHappened.placeholder: Example: They replied with one word after I waited all day...

meaning.label: Meaning
meaning.question: What did it mean to you in that moment?
meaning.placeholder: Example: It felt like I did something wrong or they were pulling away...

fear.label: Fear
fear.question: What were you afraid of?
fear.placeholder: Example: That they would leave, reject me, or stop caring...

emotion.label: Emotion
emotion.question: What emotion showed up?
emotion.placeholder: Example: Anxiety, anger, shame, sadness, emptiness...

urge.label: Urge
urge.question: What urge appeared?
urge.placeholder: Example: Text again, withdraw, argue, apologize, check social media...

action.label: Action
action.question: What did you do?
action.placeholder: Example: I sent another text, stayed quiet, distracted myself...

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.question: What happened next?
outcome.placeholder: Example: I felt relief for a minute, then more anxious...

summary.patternFallback: Keep tracking this to see the pattern more clearly.
summary.suggestedNextStep: Suggested next step: choose one calming or delaying action before reacting further.

calm.title: Calm Me Down
calm.body: We will slow your breathing, anchor your senses, and name what may be driving the urgency.
calm.intensityBefore: How intense is it right now?
calm.exhaleCue: Let the exhale be slow and complete.
calm.followCue: Follow the cue and keep it gentle.
anchors: Press your feet into the floor and notice what is holding you up.
Look for one straight line, one soft color, and one object that is not moving.
Place one hand somewhere steady. Let your body know this is this moment, not every moment.
calm.patternTitle: Name the wave without obeying it

support.relationship: Relationship stress can make urgency feel like danger. Right now, your only job is to slow the body down.
support.abandonment: Fear of being left can feel immediate and convincing. You do not have to solve the relationship in this exact minute.
support.shame: Shame can make your whole self feel like the problem. Right now, we are separating the feeling from who you are.
support.conflict: Conflict can keep your nervous system braced for impact. Let your body come down before you decide what to do.
support.default: This is a wave. It can be intense without being permanent. We will move through the next two minutes together.

calm.patternTrigger: {{trigger}} has shown up in your recent check-ins.
calm.patternEmotion: {{emotion}} has shown up in your recent check-ins.
calm.patternFallback: I will personalize this more as you check in and reflect.
calm.statement: “I can feel this strongly and still wait before I act.”
calm.afterBody: You do not need to be perfectly calm. A one-point shift still counts.
calm.completeBody: That is the practice: slow the body, name the wave, choose the next step from a steadier place.
calm.talkBody: Let Companion help you decide what to do next.

dontSend.title: Pause before you send
dontSend.subtitle: Paste the message. We’ll help you clarify the outcome you want and respond from a steadier place.
dontSend.outcomeQuestion: What outcome do you actually want?
dontSend.outcomeHint: Choose the outcome first so the rewrite can be emotionally regulated and effective.
dontSend.noBlock: This will never block you from sending. It gives you a pause, a pattern check, and a calmer option.
dontSend.saveExplanation: Save paused draft stores the original and selected rewrite as not sent so you can review it later in message history.
